jobs.description:
For the development of our core strategic solutions, we are currently looking for a very experienced, top motivated, hands-on:

TECHNICAL COORDINATOR

The Technical Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and driving the validation of industrial software for our coding machines. The role combines strong technical expertise, delivery accountability, and cross-functional coordination, ensuring predictable execution, high quality, and continuous improvement of both processes and solutions.

Role :

• Drive coordination Software release validation for our industrial inhouse coding machines

• Plan, coordinate, and monitor validation and release activities for customer-specific customizations.

• Actively manage planning, risks, technical dependencies, and delivery constraints, taking corrective actions through replanning, reprioritization, or mitigation when required.

• Investigate and solve technical dependencies with people in development teams, QA, deployment teams and operations. Assure availability of machines and material for validation.

• Plan and execute validation assuring operational readiness of coding machines at expected quality on the committed deadlines. Incorporate risks, constraints and dependencies into planning to be able to commit to a delivery date.

• Maintain a structured and transparent status of all ongoing validation activities

• Manage and follow up on incidents, problems, and change requests raised from operations or field technicians.

• Improve internal validation process and tooling for software release validation

• Promote and apply a continuous improvement mindset, simplifying processes, validation approaches, and technical solutions to improve efficiency, robustness, and time-to-market.

• Contribute to the software development of solution in Java

• Support activities both in the office and in the laboratory, including validation, commissioning, and operational support when required.

Profile :

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technical field (Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent).

• Minimum 2 years of experience in technical environments involving complex systems.

• Hands-on expertise in software development (industrial software, platforms, backend or custom applications)

• Good technical understanding of software engineering domain, enabling effective coordination across multidisciplinary teams.

• Proven experience in delivery-driven environments, managing timelines, priorities, dependencies, and risks.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills are key, with the ability to align stakeholders, facilitate collaboration, handle priorities, and address issues constructively.

• Ability to take a step back and maintain a global overview while remaining pragmatic and solution oriented.

• Comfortable working both in the office and on-site (support, validation, commissioning, troubleshooting).

• Proactive, reliable, and results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Curious and improvement-driven, continuously seeking to simplify processes and solutions.

• Fluent in English; Proficient in French; additional European languages are an asset.

JOIN US!

We offer an exciting and challenging role, with great potential for personal development within a unique organization in a fascinating industry. Your file will be handled with upmost confidentiality and discretion.

Descrizione

Per lo sviluppo delle nostre soluzioni strategiche fondamentali, siamo attualmente alla ricerca di una persona molto esperta, altamente motivata e operativa:

COORDINATORE TECNICO

Il Coordinatore Tecnico è responsabile del coordinamento e della gestione della validazione del software industriale per le nostre macchine di codifica. Il ruolo combina una solida competenza tecnica, responsabilità sulla consegna e coordinamento interfunzionale, garantendo un'esecuzione prevedibile, un'elevata qualità e il miglioramento continuo sia dei processi sia delle soluzioni.

Ruolo :

- Coordinare e guidare la validazione delle release software per le nostre macchine industriali di codifica sviluppate internamente
- Pianificare, coordinare e monitorare le attività di validazione e rilascio per le personalizzazioni specifiche per il cliente.
- Gestire attivamente la pianificazione, i rischi, le dipendenze tecniche e i vincoli di consegna, intraprendendo azioni correttive tramite una ripianificazione, una ridefinizione delle priorità o una mitigazione quando necessario.
- Analizzare e risolvere le dipendenze tecniche con le persone dei team di sviluppo, QA, deployment e operations. Garantire la disponibilità delle macchine e del materiale per la validazione.
- Pianificare ed eseguire la validazione, garantendo la prontezza operativa delle macchine di codifica alla qualità prevista e entro le scadenze concordate. Integrare rischi, vincoli e dipendenze nella pianificazione per poter impegnarsi su una data di consegna.
- Mantenere uno stato strutturato e trasparente di tutte le attività di validazione in corso
- Gestire e monitorare incidenti, problemi e richieste di modifica segnalati dalle operations o dai tecnici sul campo.
- Migliorare il processo interno di validazione e gli strumenti per la validazione delle release software
- Promuovere e applicare una mentalità di miglioramento continuo, semplificando processi, approcci alla validazione e soluzioni tecniche per migliorare l'efficienza, la robustezza e il tempo di commercializzazione.
- Contribuire allo sviluppo software della soluzione in Java
- Supportare le attività sia in ufficio sia in laboratorio, inclusi validazione, messa in servizio e supporto operativo quando richiesto.

Profilo :

- Laurea triennale o magistrale in un ambito tecnico (Ingegneria del software, Informatica o equivalente).
- Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in ambienti tecnici che coinvolgono sistemi complessi.
- Competenza pratica nello sviluppo software (software industriale, piattaforme, backend o applicazioni personalizzate)
- Buona comprensione tecnica dell'ambito dell'ingegneria del software, che consenta un coordinamento efficace tra team multidisciplinari.
- Esperienza comprovata in contesti orientati alla consegna, con gestione di tempistiche, priorità, dipendenze e rischi.
- Forti capacità comunicative e interpersonali sono fondamentali, insieme alla capacità di allineare gli stakeholder, facilitare la collaborazione, gestire le priorità e affrontare i problemi in modo costruttivo.
- Capacità di fare un passo indietro e mantenere una visione d'insieme, con un approccio pragmatico e orientato alle soluzioni.
- A proprio agio nel lavorare sia in ufficio sia sul campo (supporto, validazione, messa in servizio, risoluzione dei problemi).
- Proattivo, affidabile e orientato ai risultati, con una forte propensione ad assumersi responsabilità e a rispondere del proprio operato.
- Curioso e orientato al miglioramento, alla continua ricerca di modi per semplificare processi e soluzioni.
- Fluente in inglese; con buona padronanza del francese; la conoscenza di altre lingue europee costituisce un vantaggio.

UNISCITI A NOI!

Offriamo un ruolo stimolante e impegnativo, con un grande potenziale di crescita personale all'interno di un'organizzazione unica in un settore affascinante. La sua candidatura sarà trattata con la massima riservatezza e discrezione.

Beschreibung

Für die Entwicklung unserer strategischen Kernlösungen suchen wir derzeit eine sehr erfahrene, hochmotivierte, praxisorientierte Fachkraft:

TECHNISCHER KOORDINATOR

Der technische Koordinator ist für die Koordination und das Vorantreiben der Validierung von Industriesoftware für unsere Codiermaschinen verantwortlich. Die Rolle vereint ausgeprägte technische Expertise, Verantwortung für die termingerechte Lieferung und bereichsübergreifende Koordination und gewährleistet dadurch eine planbare Umsetzung, hohe Qualität und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung sowohl der Prozesse als auch der Lösungen.

Rolle :

- Die Koordination der Software-Release-Validierung für unsere industriellen hauseigenen Codiermaschinen vorantreiben
- Validierungs- und Release-Aktivitäten für kundenspezifische Anpassungen planen, koordinieren und überwachen.
- Planung, Risiken, technische Abhängigkeiten und Lieferrestriktionen aktiv managen und bei Bedarf durch Neuplanung, Neupriorisierung oder Risikominderung Korrekturmaßnahmen ergreifen.
- Technische Abhängigkeiten gemeinsam mit Mitarbeitenden in Entwicklungsteams, QA, Deployment-Teams und dem Betrieb untersuchen und lösen. Die Verfügbarkeit von Maschinen und Material für die Validierung sicherstellen.
- Validierung planen und durchführen und dabei die Betriebsbereitschaft der Codiermaschinen in der erwarteten Qualität zu den zugesagten Terminen sicherstellen. Risiken, Einschränkungen und Abhängigkeiten in die Planung einbeziehen, um sich auf ein Lieferdatum festlegen zu können.
- Den Status aller laufenden Validierungsaktivitäten strukturiert und transparent halten
- Vorfälle, Probleme und Änderungsanfragen verwalten und nachverfolgen, die vom Betrieb oder von Außendiensttechnikern gemeldet werden.
- Den internen Validierungsprozess und die Tools für die Software-Release-Validierung verbessern
- Eine Denkweise der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung fördern und anwenden, Prozesse, Validierungsansätze und technische Lösungen vereinfachen, um Effizienz, Robustheit und die Zeit bis zur Markteinführung zu verbessern.
- Zur Softwareentwicklung der Lösung in Java beitragen
- Aktivitäten sowohl im Büro als auch im Labor unterstützen, einschließlich Validierung, Inbetriebnahme und betrieblicher Unterstützung bei Bedarf.

Profil :

- Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in einem technischen Fachgebiet (Softwaretechnik, Informatik oder gleichwertig).
- Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in technischen Umgebungen mit komplexen Systemen.
- Fundierte praktische Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung (Industriesoftware, Plattformen, Backend oder kundenspezifische Anwendungen)
- Gutes technisches Verständnis des Bereichs Softwaretechnik, das eine effektive Koordination über multidisziplinäre Teams hinweg ermöglicht.
- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in lieferorientierten Umgebungen sowie im Management von Zeitplänen, Prioritäten, Abhängigkeiten und Risiken.
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten sind entscheidend, ebenso die Fähigkeit, Stakeholder aufeinander abzustimmen, die Zusammenarbeit zu erleichtern, Prioritäten zu bewältigen und Probleme konstruktiv anzugehen.
- Fähigkeit, einen Schritt zurückzutreten und den Gesamtüberblick zu behalten, dabei jedoch pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert zu bleiben.
- Sicheres Arbeiten sowohl im Büro als auch vor Ort (Support, Validierung, Inbetriebnahme, Fehlerbehebung).
- Proaktiv, zuverlässig und ergebnisorientiert, mit ausgeprägtem Verantwortungsbewusstsein und hoher Eigenverantwortung.
- Neugierig und auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung ausgerichtet, stets bestrebt, Prozesse und Lösungen zu vereinfachen.

COORDINATEUR TECHNIQUE

Le coordinateur technique est chargé de coordonner et de piloter la validation des logiciels industriels pour nos machines de codage. Ce poste associe une solide expertise technique, une responsabilité en matière de livraison et une coordination interfonctionnelle, afin de garantir une exécution prévisible, une qualité élevée et l’amélioration continue des processus et des solutions.

Rôle :

- Piloter la coordination de la validation des versions logicielles pour nos machines de codage industrielles développées en interne
- Planifier, coordonner et suivre les activités de validation et de mise à disposition des personnalisations spécifiques aux clients.
- Gérer activement la planification, les risques, les dépendances techniques et les contraintes de livraison, en prenant des mesures correctives par une replanification, une repriorisation ou une atténuation lorsque nécessaire.
- Étudier et résoudre les dépendances techniques avec les membres des équipes de développement, d’assurance qualité (QA), de déploiement et d’exploitation. Garantir la disponibilité des machines et du matériel nécessaires à la validation.

- Maintenir un état structuré et transparent de toutes les activités de validation en cours
- Gérer et assurer le suivi des incidents, problèmes et demandes de changement remontés par les opérations ou les techniciens de terrain.
- Améliorer le processus de validation interne et les outils de validation des versions logicielles
- Promouvoir et appliquer un état d’esprit d’amélioration continue, en simplifiant les processus, les approches de validation et les solutions techniques afin d’améliorer l’efficacité, la robustesse et le délai de mise sur le marché.

- Soutenir les activités au bureau et au laboratoire, notamment la validation, la mise en service et le support opérationnel lorsque nécessaire.

- Minimum 2 ans d’expérience dans des environnements techniques impliquant des systèmes complexes.
- Expertise pratique du développement logiciel (logiciels industriels, plateformes, back-end ou applications sur mesure)
- Bonne compréhension technique du domaine de l’ingénierie logicielle, permettant une coordination efficace entre des équipes pluridisciplinaires.
- Expérience avérée dans des environnements axés sur la livraison, avec la gestion des délais, des priorités, des dépendances et des risques.
- De solides compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles sont essentielles, ainsi que la capacité à aligner les parties prenantes, à faciliter la collaboration, à gérer les priorités et à traiter les problèmes de manière constructive.
- Capacité à prendre du recul et à conserver une vue d’ensemble tout en restant pragmatique et axé sur les solutions.
- À l’aise pour travailler aussi bien au bureau que sur site (assistance, validation, mise en service, dépannage).
- Proactif, fiable et axé sur les résultats, avec un fort sens de l’engagement et des responsabilités.
- Curieux et animé par l’amélioration continue, cherchant constamment à simplifier les processus et les solutions.

jobs.description:
To strengthen our GLOBAL INFORMATION SERVICES department, we are looking for a:

AI & DATA SOLUTION EXPERT

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a Data & AI Solution Expert to shape the technical direction of our enterprise Data & AI ecosystem and turn advanced data and Generative AI capabilities into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.

This senior individual-contributor role combines architecture with hands-on delivery across Microsoft Fabric, SQL Server, Power BI and enterprise AI. Working with engineering, architecture, security and business teams, you will define reusable standards, guide strategic designs and help move critical data and AI solutions from concept to operation in a regulated environment.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES:

• Contribute to defining the Data & AI solution architecture, reference patterns and technical standards aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, security and governance requirements.

• Design and evolve the enterprise data platform on Microsoft Fabric and SQL Server, covering ingestion, Lakehouse and Warehouse layers, data modeling, performance,  resilience and lifecycle management.

• Scale trusted analytics through reusable Power BI semantic models, shared KPIs, certified  datasets and governed self-service reporting.

• Design and deliver Generative AI applications, RAG solutions and governed data agents using Azure OpenAI and the Microsoft AI ecosystem, from  prototype through secure production deployment.

• Contribute to defining and implementing engineering, DevOps,  MLOps and LLMOps practices, including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, observability and rollback.

• Embed data governance,  security and Responsible AI into solutions through metadata, lineage, data quality, access controls, traceability, evaluation and human oversight.

• Contribute senior technical  expertise , mentor engineers, review strategic designs and explain technical options and trade-offs clearly to business and technology stakeholders.

YOUR PROFILE:

• Strong experience designing and delivering enterprise data, analytics or AI solutions, supported by a relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Advanced SQL and Microsoft SQL Server knowledge, with experience in data modeling, query optimization, Data Warehouse,  Lakehouse and ETL/ELT architectures.

• Hands-on Power BI  expertise , particularly semantic modeling, shared datasets, security and enterprise deployment.

• Practical experience with a modern cloud Data & AI platform; Microsoft Fabric is strongly preferred.

• Experience delivering Generative AI solutions using Azure OpenAI or comparable enterprise LLM technologies, with knowledge of RAG, semantic or vector search, grounding,  agents and tool calling.

• Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment  automation and the operational requirements of MLOps or LLMOps .

• Good understanding of enterprise security, identity, access management, data  governance and Responsible AI.

• Ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture,  governance and business teams, with professional proficiency in English.

JOIN US !

• Our success comes from our highly skilled and talented employees.

• Respectful entrepreneurship and long-term vision are key for success.

• Our people contribute to a more secure world.

• Diversity at all levels of an organisation is a strength.

We offer an exciting and challenging role, with great potential for personal development within a unique organization in a fascinating and fast-growing industry. Your file will be handled with upmost confidentiality and discretion.

•    Principal Engineer with a strong track record of delivering production software.

•    Strong knowledge of software architecture, API design, testing strategy, secure coding practices, and maintaining high-quality codebases.
•    Hands-on experience building and optimizing computer vision / image processing pipelines on mobile devices and under real-world constraints (latency, memory, device variability).

jobs.title: Business Architect
jobs.description:
We are expanding our Enterprise Architecture practice and seeking a Business Architect to enhance the alignment between our IT application and service portfolio and the evolving needs of the business. In this role, you will ensure that our applications and services deliver optimal value for cost, support informed investment decisions, and contribute to long‑term efficiency and transparency across IT and business domains.

As a Business Architect, you will collaborate closely with business leaders, the Enterprise Architect, and IT teams acting as a trusted strategic partner rather than a delivery or solution‑design role. You will play a pivotal part in bridging business priorities with IT capabilities, defining and maintaining the business architecture of the organization.

You will also operate across departmental and functional boundaries, as internal solutions are frequently extended to serve other business areas and external‑facing initiatives, requiring a consistent architectural view across the organization.

Your focus will be to ensure that business capabilities, processes, and value streams are fully aligned with our strategic objectives and supported by a coherent and future‑ready architecture landscape.

ROLE

• Develop and maintain the Business Capability Map and ensure its alignment with strategic objectives.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to model value streams, business processes, and operating models.

• Facilitate workshops and discussions to identify capability gaps, redundancies, and transformation opportunities.

• Define and maintain business architecture standards, principles

• Map business capabilities to applications and data assets in coordination with Application/Solution Architects.

• Support enterprise transformation, portfolio planning, and initiative prioritization using business architecture artifacts.

• Provide business context for solution and technical architecture decisions during project planning and design.

• Contribute to the definition of target state architecture from a business perspective.

• Participate in governance processes to ensure architectural compliance and documentation.

• Participate in cross‑departmental and cross‑functional initiatives, ensuring that internal solutions designed for one business area are reusable, scalable, and integrates with other departments and potential external‑facing projects.

• Act as a connector across business domains, aligning architectural decisions between departments to avoid duplication and maximize the value of internal shared solutions.

PROFILE

Technical Skills:

• Strong understanding of enterprise IT architecture, including application, data, and infrastructure layers.

• Strong understanding of capability modeling, operating models, and business process frameworks.

• Experience with solution design methodologies and modeling tools (e.g., ArchiMate, UML).

• Familiarity with EA frameworks (TOGAF, or Zachman).

• Experience with ERP, CRM, or other enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce) is a plus.

• Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance standards.

Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to lead workshops and facilitate cross-functional collaboration.

• Adaptability and a proactive mindset in dynamic environments.

Preferred Experience:

• 10+ years in IT architecture, solution design, or business analysis roles.

• Experience in large-scale transformation or digitalization projects.

• Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain, or regulated industries is a plus.

• Experience using architecture modeling tools (e.g., LeanIX, Ardoq, Sparx EA).

WHY JOIN US?

• Join a global leader in trust technologies with a mission that matters.

• Be at the strategic heart of a financially sound and innovation-driven company.

• Collaborate with high-level experts and work on impactful international projects.

• Operate in a multi-cultural, high-integrity environment where autonomy and ownership are encouraged.

• Monitor project actuals against planned budgets and escalate risks where appropriate.

• L'esposizione a industrie manifatturiere, filiali o regolamentate è un plus.

• Esperienza utilizzando strumenti di modellazione dell'architettura (ad esempio, LeanIX, Ardoq, Sparx EA).

jobs.title: Senior Patent Counsel
jobs.description:
The primary objective of this role is to ensure that technology identification, extraction and protection are aligned with the business activities in the field of chemistry. A strong understanding of the underlying technologies and their commercial applications is therefore essential to success in this position.

The in-house Patent Attorney will act as a hands-on partner to the business, advising on day-to-day business development opportunities and ensuring that new innovations are effectively identified and protected through patents. Working closely with the Research & Innovation (R&I) team and the IP department, the role will focus on innovation extraction, patent drafting and prosecution.

The role requires a proactive, collaborative approach, working across R&I, Commercial and Legal teams to ensure that intellectual property protection supports the company's broader business objectives. The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise messages and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels is essential.

Key responsibilities

• Work closely with the Research & Innovation team, harvest and capture innovation. Pro-actively look for inventions and create and maintain awareness about use and necessity of patent applications.

• Contribute to the acquisition, protection, defence and enforcement (drafting, filing, prosecution, opposition, appeal, etc.) of patent rights; prosecution of a global patent portfolio in the assigned technical areas.

• Provide comprehensive patent support to selected projects as an integral member of multidisciplinary project teams.

• Formulate strategic practice recommendations in response to commercial, legal and technical developments, this includes evaluating patent validity, patent risk management and infringement issues and reviewing IP-related agreements.

Essential duties

• Analysis of the innovation and potential inventions, drafting, filing of patent applications and worldwide prosecution; therefore, drafting skills are essential here and prosecution, opposition and infringement matters offer a wide variety of work.

• Liaise prior art search reports from external providers and assess feasibility and patentability.

• Draft IP related aspects of agreements with third-party collaborators and service providers.

• Oversee patent risk management and provide Freedom to Operate opinion and clearance studies.

• Working closely with R&I division, sales and legal and promote patent culture with good visibility within the company. The direct contact with international colleagues and clients will require commitment, passion, strong communication skills and commercial savviness.

Profile

• PhD (preferred) or master’s degree in chemistry.

• Be passionate about the technology you work with and follow the developments within the industry with invested interest.

• Qualified European Patent Attorney. Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in drafting and prosecuting patent cases after EPA qualification.

• Proactive, structured with a collaborative working style with solid team player attributes with the ability to manage relationships with different stakeholders in the company.

• Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills to work with cross-functional teams across departments and divisions.

• Show flexibility under stress and delivers quality work with strong attention to detail in an autonomous manner.

• Fluent in English, French a strong asset is a plus
